verdict.rationale: Grok Bot has no explicit 'project' or 'space' feature. Its own equivalent is a named Bot that keeps its memory, files, and preferences across sessions and is set up by describing its job, so chats with that Bot share context and instructions; group chats also let several Bots share context. A month-long user confirms each Bot owns its own context and domain. Missing for 10: an explicit project/space container for grouping related chats and files, documented project-level shared instructions, and the ability to move existing chats or files into such a grouping.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can organize related chats and files into a project or space that shares context and instructions

citations.quote: A named Bot keeps its memory, files, browser sessions, and preferences across sessions instead of resetting on every task.
Create a Bot, describe the job, and grant access as it asks.
each bot owns its own routines, context and domain
